from pathlib import Path
import os,subprocess,json,stat,datetime
print('OBSERVED_UTC',datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat())
def run(args,t=20):
 try:
  q=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=t)
  return q.returncode,q.stdout.strip(),q.stderr.strip()
 except Exception as e:return -2,'',type(e).__name__
def du(p):
 rc,out,err=run(['du','-x','-s','-B1',str(p)],35)
 return out.split()[0] if rc==0 else '?'

items=[
 ('telegram-code','/srv/projects/telegram-robot-leads'),
 ('telegram-data','/var/lib/telegram-robot-leads'),
 ('telegram-private','/root/project-secrets/telegram-robot-leads'),
 ('telegram-data-target','/srv/projects/telegram-robot-leads/data'),
 ('telegram-private-target','/srv/projects/telegram-robot-leads/private'),
 ('iptvpn-code','/srv/projects/iptvpn-bot'),
 ('iptvpn-private','/root/project-secrets/iptvpn_bot'),
 ('rea-final','/home/ubuntu/rea-final-runtime'),

 ('rea-evidence','/home/ubuntu/rea-original-upstream-680-evidence'),
 ('codex-agent','/home/ubuntu/codex-agent'),

]
for tag,path in items:
 p=Path(path)
 print('PATH',tag,path,'KIND','link' if p.is_symlink() else 'dir' if p.is_dir() else 'absent','BYTES',du(path) if p.is_dir() and not p.is_symlink() else '-','UID',p.stat().st_uid if p.exists() else '-','PERMS',oct(p.stat().st_mode&0o777) if p.exists() else '-','DEVICE',p.stat().st_dev if p.exists() else '-')
 if tag in ('telegram-data','telegram-private') and p.is_dir():
  print('PRIVATE_FILES_COUNT',tag,sum(len(fs) for _,_,fs in os.walk(p)))
  print('SESSION_COUNT',tag,sum(1 for _,_,fs in os.walk(p) for f in fs if f.endswith('.session')))

for a in json.loads(out):
 if a.get('name') not in ('telegram-robot-leads','iptvpn_bot'):continue
 e=a.get('pm2_env') or {}
 print('PM2_APP',a.get('name'),'STATUS',e.get('status'),'PID',a.get('pid'),'CWD',e.get('pm_cwd'),'SCRIPT',e.get('pm_exec_path'),'INTERPRETER',e.get('exec_interpreter'))
 for k in ['TELEGRAM_OPERATION_STATE','TELEGRAM_EVENT_JOURNAL','TELEGRAM_VAULT_DIR','TELEGRAM_PRIVATE_DIR','TELEGRAM_DATA_DIR','SESSION_DIR']:
  if k in e:
   v=str(e[k])
   print('PM2_PATH',k,v if v.startswith('/') and ('token' not in k.lower()) else 'NONABS_OR_REDACTED')
 print('PM2_ENV_PNAMES',','.join(sorted(k for k in e.keys() if ('SESSION' in k or 'STATE' in k or 'VAULT' in k or 'DATA' in k) and len(k)<70))[:1100])
print('===MAIN_STATE_REFS===')
root=Path('/srv/projects/telegram-robot-leads')
terms=['/var/lib/telegram-robot-leads','/root/project-secrets/telegram-robot-leads','/srv/projects/telegram-robot-leads','is_symlink(','.resolve(', 'TELEGRAM_OPERATION_STATE','TELEGRAM_EVENT_JOURNAL']
for f in ['main.py','ecosystem.config.js','scripts/safe_runtime.py','scripts/telethon_sessions.py','scripts/activate_project_only.py','scripts/deploy_project_only.py','scripts/telegram-robot-leads-status.sh']:
 p=root/f
 if not p.is_file():continue
 lines=p.read_text(errors='replace').splitlines()
 hits=[(i+1,l[:190]) for i,l in enumerate(lines) if any(x in l for x in terms)]
 print('REF_FILE',f,'LINES',len(lines),'HIT_COUNT',len(hits))
 for number,line in hits[:30]:print('REF',f,number,line)

for pid in Path('/proc').iterdir():
 if not pid.name.isdigit():continue
